 The Amazon Black Friday kicks off on 19 November 2026 and runs for 12 days.
 By  Ken Wong  -  19 Nov 2026 
 Amazon’s Black Friday sale is here and they’re going big. Its 12-day Black Friday Sale kicked off from midnight today, running all the way till 11.59pm on 30 November 2026. That’s nearly two weeks to hunt down the year’s best prices on gadgets, gaming gear, kitchen upgrades and gifts.
 Keep an eye on the clock, too. Flash Drops will happen three times a day, at 12am, 12pm and 6pm, in the Voucher Zone , so have your cart ready before each drop to grab additional discounts on international products.
 You can start shopping Amazon Black Friday Deals now. We’ve rounded up standout tech picks that are marked down by as much as 60%. Many of these items ship from Amazon’s International Store, so check the delivery date if you’re buying Christmas gifts. We’ll keep adding fresh deals as they drop, so check back often.
 Collect your exclusive Amazon Black Friday promo code
 Get an extra $5 off your order when you spend $50 on Amazon.sg. Limited codes available. Code is valid from now until 30 November 2026. Collect code here 
 Unsure of what to get? Purchase an Amazon eGift card instead. As part of the Amazon Black Friday sale promotions, the first 1,500 Amazon.sg customers will get an extra $15 promo credit for every $220 spent on a gift card.
